patch_description: Tune soft-min parameters per the recommendation: raise frac to 0.20 so more near-minimal triangles are lifted simultaneously, and anneal the soft-min sharpness (temp) from ~150 to ~600 within Phase 1 so the surrogate progressively sharpens toward the hard-min objective, avoiding the abrupt Phase 1→2 objective switch. Add a mid-k transition phase using frac=0.25 to lift all near-binding triangles together before the hard-min polish. Also slightly increase soft-search iterations to let the annealing converge.
